summary: 18 checks executed (11 backend pytest assertions across 5 files, 7 browser flows) covering all 8 acceptance criteria. All passed on this run.

checks.criterion: Auth + onboarding forces 3-step onboarding and lands on dashboard with a created card
checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_onboarding.py::test_signup_sets_session_and_onboarding_creates_card
checks.evidence: POST /api/auth/signup -> 200, digicon_session cookie set; GET /api/cards before onboarding -> []; POST /api/auth/onboarding -> 200 onboarded=true; GET /api/cards after -> 1 card, published=true

checks.criterion: Auth + onboarding: a brand-new signup is forced through the 3-step onboarding and lands on a dashboard with a created card
checks.name: auth-signup-onboarding-dashboard
checks.evidence: Signup -> onboarding steps 1-3 -> 'Your DigiCon is ready.' heading -> Go to dashboard -> dashboard-greeting visible -> /cards shows exactly 1 card-item

checks.criterion: Card builder: free user capped at 1 card (402)
checks.name: test_tscheck_card_builder_gating.py::test_free_user_second_card_returns_402
checks.evidence: Logged in as free@digicon.app (already owns 1 card); POST /api/cards -> 402 'Free plan includes 1 card. Upgrade to add more.'

checks.criterion: Card builder: pro user creates a 2nd card, publishes publicly with no auth
checks.name: test_tscheck_card_builder_gating.py::test_pro_user_can_create_second_card_and_it_publishes_publicly
checks.evidence: Logged in as maria@digicon.app; POST /api/cards -> 200 with slug; anonymous GET /api/public/cards/{slug} -> 200 with matching name; test cleans up its own card via DELETE

checks.criterion: Card builder creates/edits a card with live preview and publishes it at a public URL; free user gets an upgrade redirect
checks.name: card-builder-pro-create-and-publish
checks.evidence: Pro user fills builder form at /cards/new, Save navigates to /share; /c/maria-santos renders publicly (public-card-canvas visible); free user's /cards shows cards-upgrade-cta which navigates to /pricing

checks.criterion: Public card contact exchange requires no account and creates a relationship for the card owner
checks.name: test_tscheck_public_connect.py::test_public_connect_creates_relationship_for_owner
checks.evidence: Anonymous POST /api/public/cards/maria-santos/connect -> 200 ok=true; owner GET /api/relationships?q=<visitor> -> 1 row, status=New, source=public_card; test deletes the relationship it created

checks.criterion: Public card never exposes private fields (notes/opportunity_value/health)
checks.name: test_tscheck_public_connect.py::test_public_card_never_exposes_private_fields
checks.evidence: GET /api/public/cards/maria-santos -> 200; response body has no notes/opportunity_value/health/followups keys

checks.criterion: Public card contact exchange requires no account and creates a relationship for the card owner
checks.name: public-card-connect-creates-relationship
checks.evidence: On /c/maria-santos, Connect dialog submit shows public-card-connect-success panel; logged in as maria, /contacts search for the visitor name returns the new row

checks.criterion: Relationship workspace: search, status filter, detail tabs, edit, interaction log
checks.name: relationship-workspace-search-filter-edit
checks.evidence: Created tscheck- fixture relationship; search by name and by company filters to it; status filter 'New' still shows it; Context/Interactions/Edit tabs work; logged interaction appears in Interactions timeline; Edit tab company change persists after page reload

checks.criterion: Follow-ups: create from a relationship, filter, and complete
checks.name: followups-create-filter-complete
checks.evidence: Added follow-up on relationship detail Follow-ups tab -> appears in detail-followups-list and as Next action on Context tab; /followups Open/All show it, Overdue filter excludes it (due today); Complete moves it to Completed filter and logs a 'Follow-up completed' interaction visible on the relationship's Interactions tab

checks.criterion: Plan gating enforced by backend: free user 402 on analytics/export
checks.name: test_tscheck_plan_gating.py::test_free_user_gets_402_on_analytics_and_export

checks.criterion: Plan gating: pro user gets real analytics content
checks.name: test_tscheck_plan_gating.py::test_pro_user_gets_real_analytics_content

checks.criterion: Plan gating: entitlements matrix reflects plan

checks.evidence: GET /api/entitlements as free@digicon.app -> 200, analytics/wallet/landing_pwa/crm_pipeline all allowed=false

checks.name: plan-gating-ui-free-vs-pro
checks.evidence: free@digicon.app sees analytics-upgrade-gate/crm-upgrade-gate/wallet-upgrade-gate/landingpwa-upgrade-gate on /analytics /crm /wallet /landing-pwa; maria@digicon.app sees real content (analytics-insights, crm-board, wallet-panel, landingpwa-templates) on all four with no gate present

checks.criterion: Super admin area protected: non-admin gets 403 on /api/admin/stats

checks.criterion: Super admin area: admin views stats, toggles a user's plan, publishes a blog post visible publicly

checks.criterion: Super admin area is protected and the blog CMS publishes

checks.criterion: Mobile navigation and states are consistent across the app
checks.name: mobile-nav-consistency-and-empty-states
checks.evidence: At 390px width, bottom-navigation visible with correct item marked active (text-sky class) on /dashboard /cards /contacts /followups /settings; no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth<=clientWidth) on any route; free user's /contacts and /followups show contacts-empty / followups-empty states
